headline: Nigerian Naira Depreciates to 1,394 per US Dollar Ahead of Central Bank Rate Meeting
summary: The Nigerian naira closed at 1,394 per US dollar, hitting its weakest exchange level in three weeks. The currency decline comes days ahead of the Central Bank of Nigeria's upcoming monetary policy meeting.
why: The exchange rate of the naira affects domestic inflation, import expenses, and corporate foreign debt servicing across Africa's largest economy.
